description: This file defines a class 'WorkShiftMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface to configure menu options related to work shifts in the OrangeHRM system. It overrides the screen associated with the current module to 'workShift'.

classes.name: WorkShiftMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu options for the work shift module by overriding the screen to 'workShift'. Implements the MenuConfigurator interface.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current module's screen to 'workShift' using a helper method and returns null.
